props.heading: Your mentors
props.intro: Every mentor builds or repairs boats for a living. Each one looks after six students all week.

photo.alt: Tom's two boats on the harbour at sunset

props.name: Tom Penrose
props.bio: Tom has built wooden boats on this harbour for twenty years. He runs the morning workshops.

photo.alt: Boats moored by the quay outside Mei's workshop

props.name: Mei Chen
props.bio: Mei makes and mends sails in the loft above the boatshed. Ask her about knots.

photo.alt: The harbour where Dan teaches sailing

props.name: Dan Okafor
props.bio: Dan takes everyone out on the water in the afternoons, and keeps them safe.
